objective:
A Python full-text search library over a collection of documents, built in
layers.

It should provide: a tokenizer that lowercases, splits on non-letters and
removes a configurable stop-word list; an inverted index mapping each token to
the documents containing it with term frequencies; a document store holding
identifiers, titles and bodies; a query parser supporting single terms, quoted
phrases, and AND / OR / NOT between them; a ranker scoring results by term
frequency and inverse document frequency; result snippets showing matched terms
in context; index persistence to and from disk; and a command line interface
that indexes a directory of text files and answers queries.

Pure standard library. Each layer should be usable on its own.
